 Salesforce is looking for a
 **Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) \- AI Software Engineer** 
 to join the team driving the development and delivery of Agentforce. This role requires a strong backend developer who will play a pivotal role in maintaining our core execution engines, handling complex orchestration, and ultimately building the next generation of intelligent agents.
   

  

 You will work on impactful generative AI platforms, applications, and products used by millions of people every day, ensuring their stability, security, and future evolution.
   

  

**The Team**
 We are a group of Generative AI Application Engineers who are passionate about designing products and building intelligent agents that work alongside humans to drive customer success 24/7\. We love to learn, teach, and help each other, and we seek core product developers with a collaborative attitude, strong problem\-solving skills, and openness to others’ ideas.
   

  

**The Role**
 As an SMTS, your journey will bridge the optimization of our current core systems with the creation of next\-generation AI reasoning.
   

  

* Phase 1 (Legacy Optimization): You will start by taking ownership of our legacy React Planner. This is a tricky, business\-critical system that requires a developer who loves deep\-dive problem\-solving. Your initial focus will be on driving stability, resolving complex bugs, addressing customer escalations, and implementing critical security fixes. While new feature development will be lighter in this phase, your work will be vital to keeping the platform robust.
* Phase 2 (Next\-Gen Evolution): As you master the architecture, you will transition to working on our new reasoner. Here, you will actively build out new reasoning features, integrate generative AI services, design pipelines, and implement citations/guardrails for LLMs.


 You will participate in the end\-to\-end AI product development lifecycle, collaborating with AI Platform Engineers and Software Engineers to develop scalable, reusable workflows.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Maintain, debug, and optimize the legacy React Planner engine, ensuring high availability, security, and rapid resolution of customer issues.
* Transition into designing and building new reasoning features and capabilities for the next\-generation Agentforce reasoner.
* Build and own end\-to\-end scalable services that can be integrated with numerous applications, support thousands of tenants, and operate at scale in production.
* Drive system efficiencies through automation, including capacity planning, configuration management, performance tuning, monitoring, and root cause analysis.
* Participate in periodic on\-call rotations and be available to resolve critical production issues.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Application Architects, Data Scientists, and Deep Learning Researchers to bring innovative technologies to production.


**Required Skills**
 5
 **\+ years of industry experience**
* In software engineering, with a proven track record as a core backend product developer (This is a core R\&D developer role, not a CCE or FDE position).
* Strong programming skills in Java (the role starts heavily in Java) with a solid understanding of object\-oriented design.
* Strong programming skills in Python, with experience or a strong interest in building ML pipelines.
* Bachelors (or) Masters degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related STEM field with strong competencies in algorithms, data structures, and software design.
* Excellent debugging and triage skills; a passion for digging into legacy codebases to solve complex bugs and security vulnerabilities.
* Experience with distributed, scalable systems and modern data storage, messaging, and processing frameworks (e.g., Kafka, Docker, Spark).
* Basic understanding of deep learning, machine learning algorithms, LLMs, and prompt engineering.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills; the ability to tackle problems the world has yet to solve.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience developing applications/services for complex business use cases and large amounts of unstructured data.
* Experience with conversational AI and fine\-tuning methods for LLMs.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a track record of driving collaboration across multiple technical teams.

**What We Do**
 Rillet serves accounting and finance teams. Our customers are the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.
   

  

 Rillet is an AI\-native ERP that can drive a zero\-day close. We are different because of our unified source\-of\-truth data model, hundreds of best\-in\-class native integrations (Stripe, Ramp, Salesforce, etc), automated \& auditable workflows, multi\-entity consolidation, and quickly expanding army of specialized AI agents (e.g., accrual, audit, P\&L flux, board decks, etc). These earn us a consistently perfect customer satisfaction score. High\-growth AI customers like Mercor, and Function Health love our ship velocity, because their financial stack needs to scale as quickly as they do.
   

  

 This huge market is ours to take. We have raised $100M from leading investors (including Sequoia, a16z, Iconiq, Oak HC/FT, and First Round) to
 **help everyone run their numbers at the speed of AI.**
**Who We Are**
 Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.
   

  

 Successful Rilleteers do not wait for assignments. They internalize a mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.
   

  

 Work revolves around our customers. Successful Rilleteers are energized by delivering the most important things, even those that weren’t in the original plan.
   

  

 In this role, you do not need to be an accountant. But you do need to appreciate the value that our customers can create for their own company when we equip them with the perfect financial tools. Successful Rilleteers love powering the financial core of the world’s fastest\-growing companies.
   

  

**Who We Need**
 Experienced engineers who've made infrastructure a competitive advantage — not just reliable plumbing. You've owned the systems that let product teams ship with confidence, you think in tradeoffs, and you care deeply about how a team builds, not just what ships.
   

  

 We're building industry\-defining accounting and finance software. Our platform needs to scale with us, and we want an engineer who brings a point of view to that work.
   

  

**Our Tech Stack:** 
 Svelte 5/TypeScript frontend, Kotlin \+ Spring Boot backend, PostgreSQL, AWS. We're AI\-native — meaning thoughtful application, not outsourced thinking. Our engineers still reason from first principles; AI helps with execution.
   

  

 We're looking for teammates within commutable distance of our NYC or SF offices (or willing to relocate). The team works in\-office Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the infrastructure, CI/CD, and developer tooling that keeps our engineering team shipping fast and safely at scale
* Set the technical direction for reliability, security, and compliance — building these in from the ground up rather than bolting them on later
* Shape the design and scalability of our external API, turning it into a competitive asset for customers and partners
* Partner with engineering leadership to define roadmap priorities and translate ambiguous problems into clear technical plans
* Raise the bar for engineering quality through design reviews, mentorship, and hands\-on collaboration


 Who We're Looking For
   

  

* 5\+ years of software engineering experience with a track record on complex, large\-scale projects
* Deep expertise in AWS — this is our primary cloud and you'll own it
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD, observability tooling, and distributed systems
* Comfortable making technical decisions and navigating hard tradeoffs at whatever scope your role demands
* Energized by building in a fast\-moving environment where the playbook is still being written


**Bonus Points**
* Experience building or maintaining third\-party integrations (ERP, fintech, or similar)
* Background in fintech, ERP, or accounting software
* Experience owning and scaling public\-facing APIs
* Familiarity with enterprise readiness (SOC 2, SSO/SAML, audit logging, or similar)
* Kotlin, Java, or TypeScript experience
* Prior experience at a high\-growth startup

**Job Title: Embedded Software Engineer**
**Job Description**
 This onsite Embedded Software Engineer role in Loveland, CO focuses on designing and developing embedded firmware for next\-generation water quality instrumentation. You will work in a large, state\-of\-the\-art R\&D campus, collaborating closely with cross\-functional engineering teams to build new products and ground\-up architectures rather than sustaining legacy systems. The role combines embedded Linux, RTOS, and bare\-metal development with hands\-on hardware interaction, offering the opportunity to make a direct impact on global water quality while contributing to a growing, collaborative firmware team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and develop embedded firmware solutions for new and existing water quality instrumentation products.
* Develop and maintain embedded software using C\+\+ (and sometimes C) for microcontrollers and platforms including Linux, RTOS, and bare metal environments.
* Modify and extend existing code bases to meet evolving product and system requirements.
* Analyze requirements, estimate development effort, and deliver reliable, impactful solutions on schedule.
* Collaborate in an Agile team environment, participating in daily scrums, weekly development discussions, and sprint activities.
* Work closely with hardware engineers, reading schematics and interacting directly with hardware to debug and optimize system performance.
* Troubleshoot and debug embedded systems using tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and digital multimeters.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD practices and unit testing to support robust, repeatable builds and high\-quality releases.
* Ensure code quality and reliability through rigorous debugging, testing, and adherence to best practices.
* Produce clear technical design documentation and contribute to system and industrial instrumentation architecture discussions.
* Develop and maintain device drivers and kernel\-level software, focusing on hardware interfaces and Linux internal behavior rather than only user\-space applications.
* Implement and support low\-level hardware interfaces and communication protocols including I2C, SPI, UART, MODBUS, USB, and Ethernet.
* Engage in hands\-on coding, building, deploying, and debugging activities throughout the development lifecycle.
* Participate in technical interviews and hands\-on exercises to assess, mentor, and support the growth of engineering talent.
* Collaborate with diverse, cross\-disciplinary teams in a highly integrated environment where design, R\&D, testing, and manufacturing are largely in\-house.
* Contribute to the growth and maturation of the firmware team, helping define and build new product architectures and development practices.
* Work on new product development initiatives, focusing on ground\-up architectures for embedded systems and instrumentation rather than primarily sustaining work.


**Essential Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related engineering field, or equivalent applicable experience.
* 3\+ years of experience in C\+\+ user\-space development and C (or embedded C) programming for embedded systems.
* 3\+ years of experience with 32\-bit microcontrollers and embedded platforms, including Linux, RTOS, and bare metal environments.
* Strong understanding of computer architecture, memory technologies, and software build processes.
* Proficiency working in embedded Linux environments, with a focus on Linux internals, kernel device drivers, and hardware interaction rather than only application\-level development.
* Experience with device driver and kernel programming for embedded Linux platforms.
* Ability to read and interpret hardware schematics and work confidently with low\-level hardware interfaces.
* Ability to code low\-level hardware interfaces and interact directly with peripherals and sensors.
* Familiarity with industrial instrumentation architecture beyond general\-purpose computing or storage\-focused systems.
* Strong understanding and hands\-on experience with communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, UART, MODBUS, USB, and Ethernet.
* Proficiency in Agile methodologies and experience working in Agile software development teams.
* Strong debugging skills in both software and hardware environments, including use of oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and digital multimeters.
* Ability to produce technical design documentation and contribute to system\-level design discussions.
* Demonstrated ability to work comfortably with both hardware and software in a firmware/embedded software engineering capacity.
* Prior professional experience working with C\+\+ in embedded or systems\-level contexts.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative engineering team, taking ownership of tasks from concept through deployment.


**Additional Skills \& Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Embedded Systems Engineering or a closely related field.
* 5\+ years of professional embedded software experience is strongly preferred; candidates with a minimum of 2–3 years of strong, relevant experience and a demonstrated ability to learn quickly will be considered.
* Experience developing in a Linux desktop environment using both IDEs and command\-line tools.
* Experience with Embedded Linux build systems such as Yocto.
* Understanding of real\-time operating systems (RTOS) and bare\-metal development, including hardware interface design and implementation.
* Proficiency with scripting languages such as Shell or Bash, and familiarity with Python.
* Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP.
* Experience with Docker containers in a development or test environment.
* Exposure to user interface technologies such as React.js and Node.js is a plus.
* Experience in the water quality industry or with industrial instrumentation is a plus.
* Experience working in a diverse, inclusive, and highly collaborative engineering environment.
* Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts and trade\-offs to both hardware and software stakeholders.
* A proactive, “go\-getter” mindset with a strong appetite for learning new technologies and taking on challenging problems.
* Comfort working in an environment that emphasizes in\-house design, testing, and manufacturing capabilities.


**Work Environment**
 This role is based at a large, multi\-building campus in Loveland, CO, with a minimum expectation of four days per week onsite and Friday as a flexible day. The campus includes a state\-of\-the\-art building designed specifically for research and development, along with extensive in\-house capabilities such as a 10\-meter EMC chamber, HALT chamber, PCA/SMT line, injection molding, fabrication, and full production/manufacturing facilities. You will work in a collaborative environment that feels like an advanced, hands\-on engineering design lab, with close\-knit teams spanning nearly all engineering disciplines. The workday typically includes a daily scrum around 9 a.m., alignment on tasks and goals, and then focused time spent writing code, building and deploying firmware, troubleshooting and debugging hardware and software, and engaging in weekly development discussions to address system issues and interface requirements. The organization operates within a global network focused on water quality solutions, offering a culture that values innovation, collaboration, diversity, inclusion, and professional growth. **Job Title:** 
 Junior Software Developer
 



**Location:** 
 Hybrid; primarily remote with the exception of in\-person meetings
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time, exempt
 



  





**About Us:** 
 Third Eye Health is dedicated to delivering high\-quality, nurse\-centric support for patient\-centered care through innovative telehealth solutions within skilled nursing facilities, provider groups, health systems, and health plans. Our mission is to enhance patient outcomes by leveraging technology and provide renown post\-acute care services; by connecting the right people at the right time for every encounter. Third Eye Health delivers seamless, clinician\-led patient care during daytime and after\-hours coverage periods.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 
 The Junior Software Developer will plan, develop and provide updates to our specialized application software such as our mobile application that allows for secure messaging, picture sharing and live video calling, and other clinician consultation and documentation applications. This role reports to the CTO.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Collaborates with internal teams to understand user needs; drafts initial design of software to meet these needs.
* Assesses feasibility of design and project parameters within time and cost constraints.
* Analyzes user needs and designs software for client use.
* Develops code and designs software applications based on user specifications.
* Modifies existing software to correct errors or improve performance.
* Monitors and assists with software testing and validation procedures and programming.
* Monitors and assists with software installation; ensures application operates within established specifications.
* Gathers and evaluates user feedback and then modifies software for better usability.
* Designs databases for specific application areas.
* Collaborates with systems analysts, engineers, and programmers to design systems to support required applications.
* Additional duties as assigned.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* 1\-5 years of experience as software developer or engineer preferred.
* SQL: 2\-years’ experience required.
* C\#: 2\-years’ experience required.
* Swift (iOS): 1\-year of experience required.
* Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field required.
* Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field preferred.



  





**Physical Requirements:** 



* Ability to perform the essential job functions consistently and successfully with the ADA, FMLA and other federal, state, and local standards, including meeting productivity standards.
* The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop; kneel, crouch or crawl; talk or hear.
* Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.
* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer, tablet or mobile device.
* Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.



  





**Working Conditions:** 



* Work will be performed in a home office setting.
* Must maintain a HIPAA compliant dedicated space in the home office setting to complete documentation and to conduct telehealth visits. This space must provide privacy to protect PHI/PII and provide a professional backdrop for video conferencing.
* Access to Wi\-Fi required.
